# Netherlands

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Betaalvereniging Nederland / Dutch Payments Association

**Role:** National coordination and implementation-guideline publisher

**Reporting coverage:** Maintains national CAMT 053 implementation guidelines; public sources reviewed do not establish separate national 052/054 guides.

**Messages / versions:** camt.053; pain.001; pain.008

- [National CAMT 053 overview](https://www.betaalvereniging.nl/kennisbank/standaarden-in-betalingsverkeer/camt-053/) — availability; public-page
- [Standards catalog with 053 guidelines 1.1 and 2.0](https://www.betaalvereniging.nl/kennisbank/standaarden-in-betalingsverkeer/) — availability; public-page
- [CAMT 053 guideline 1.1, October 2013](https://www.betaalvereniging.nl/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/IG-Bank-to-Customer-Statement-CAMT-053-v1-1.pdf) — specification; public-file
- [CAMT 053 guideline 2.0 download](https://www.betaalvereniging.nl/en/download/3874/?tmstv=1773826301) — specification; linked-unverified
- [Guideline 2.0 publication announcement, August 2016](https://www.betaalvereniging.nl/actueel/nieuws/nieuwe-versie-2-0-camt-053-xml-bericht-bank-to-customer-statement/) — availability; public-page

Public catalog offers 053 guidelines 1.1 and 2.0. Catalog lists the same 2013 date for both, while the historical announcement says 2.0 was published 2016 and implemented 2017. Guideline version numbers are separate from ISO namespace versions; do not assume v08.
